item.text: I’m using the ui-ux-pro-max skill to build a quiet, editorial portfolio with custom project illustrations, readable writing, and responsive light and dark themes.

item.text: The design direction is warm paper, blue ink, generous typography, and four illustrated product previews. I’m building the writing filters, persistent theme switch, project notes, and an email form with clear feedback for this standalone page.

item.text: The page is written, including all four project illustrations, six filterable posts, a 397-word featured essay, and the about section. I’m checking responsive layouts, keyboard accessibility, and the theme and form behavior before finishing.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('index.html');s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('min-height:34px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;list-style:none','min-height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;list-style:none')
s=s.replace('right:0;top:14px;width:40px;height:40px','right:0;top:12px;width:44px;height:44px')
s=s.replace('padding-inline:10px;min-height:40px','padding-inline:10px;min-height:44px')
s=s.replace('An occasional note from my desk','A letter from my desk')
p.write_text(s)
print('Written:',p.resolve())
print('Output files:', ', '.join(x.name for x in Path('.').iterdir() if x.is_file()))
print('File size:',len(s.encode()),'bytes')
PY"

item.text:
Created [index.html](index.html) with all requested content, inline SVG illustrations, responsive layouts, theme switching, and working post filters.

Newsletter includes validation and demo feedback; no email service is connected.
